subject.title: fix: whatsapp replies before rich context is debounced

question: Should WhatsApp non-audio rich inbound messages stop following the documented immediate media/attachment dispatch contract and instead enter configured inbound debounce?
rationale: Current docs and current main say media/attachments flush immediately, while this PR intentionally changes reply timing and batching for existing configured WhatsApp users.

options.title: Accept rich-context debouncing
options.body: Update the documented WhatsApp/inbound debounce contract, keep voice notes and control commands immediate, require upgrade notes and real WhatsApp proof, then merge after mechanical fixes.

options.title: Preserve media immediacy
options.body: Keep the current media/attachment bypass and narrow the fix to cases that do not contradict the documented text-only debounce contract.

options.title: Pause for wider channel policy
options.body: Hold this PR until maintainers decide whether rich-media debounce needs an explicit compatibility mode or a broader channel policy change.

recommendation.title: Accept rich-context debouncing
recommendation.body: Update the documented WhatsApp/inbound debounce contract, keep voice notes and control commands immediate, require upgrade notes and real WhatsApp proof, then merge after mechanical fixes.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent WhatsApp inbound debounce and channel-lifecycle ownership makes this the best available routing owner for the behavior-contract decision.
